```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("figure3")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04", "05", "06"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "cea_helpers", "report_format",
           "psa_functions", "evppi_functions", "scenario_analysis"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- psa_obj_path()
psa_obj <- load_current_psa_cache()

scatter_data <- data.frame()
if (!is.null(psa_obj)) {
  cost_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$cost)
  effect_df <- if (!is.null(psa_obj$effect)) {
    as.data.frame(psa_obj$effect)
  } else {
    as.data.frame(psa_obj$effectiveness)
  }

  control_strategy <- get_control_strategy()
  for (strategy in intersect(get_biomarkers(), psa_obj$strategies)) {
    scatter_data <- rbind(scatter_data, data.frame(
      inc_effect = effect_df[[strategy]] - effect_df[[control_strategy]],
      inc_cost = cost_df[[strategy]] - cost_df[[control_strategy]],
      Strategy = strategy_labels[[strategy]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

make_ce_plane <- function(data, point_alpha, point_size) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = inc_effect, y = inc_cost, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = WTP, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", big.mark = ",")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("CRP-guided" = "#E69F00",
                                  "TMB/BRAF-guided" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = "Incremental effectiveness (QALYs)",
         y = "Incremental cost (EUR)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

## Figure 3

```{r figure-3, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
if (nrow(scatter_data) > 0) {
  p_ce <- make_ce_plane(scatter_data, point_alpha = 0.18, point_size = 0.5)
  print(p_ce)
} else {
  cat("PSA cache not available. Run analysis/10_PSA.R first.")
}
```

## Figure S3

```{r figure-s3, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
if (nrow(scatter_data) > 0) {
  p_ce_s3 <- make_ce_plane(scatter_data, point_alpha = 0.12, point_size = 0.35)
  print(p_ce_s3)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_ce")) {
  figs_dir <- here("outputs", "figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  save_artifact_plot(here("outputs", "figs", "figure3.png"), p_ce, width = 9, height = 8,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
if (exists("p_ce_s3")) {
  save_artifact_plot(here("outputs", "figs", "figure_s3.png"), p_ce_s3, width = 9, height = 7,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

Figures 3 and S3 have been saved to `outputs/figs/figure3.png` and `outputs/figs/figure_s3.png`.
